name: edgefetch-hub
description: Cloudflare Hibernating WebSocket Durable Object coordinator, /admin Control Center, and Self-Hosted OAuth 2.1 /mcp server for EdgeFetch.

scripts.deploy:dry: node scripts/compile-manifests.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.toml --env="" && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.toml -e production
scripts.deploy: node scripts/compile-manifests.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.toml -e production

CALLER_TOKEN.description: Owner/API secret (>= 24 random chars, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`) used to sign into /admin, authorize OAuth 2.1 /mcp grants, and authenticate POST /fetch.

AGENT_TOKENS.description: JSON map of per-site edge worker secrets (>= 24 random chars each), e.g. {"site-1":"<secret-1>","site-2":"<secret-2>"}.
